name: ScreenshotOne
tagline: Website screenshot API with full-page capture, caching, and signed URLs
description: ScreenshotOne is a modern website screenshot API that captures screenshots of web pages programmatically. It supports full-page capture, caching, signed URLs for secure client-side use, custom viewport sizes, blocking ads/cookie banners, and various image formats. Designed for developers who need reliable, automated website screenshots for monitoring, previews, thumbnails, or documentation.

auth.details: Access key and secret key via query params (access_key, secret_key) or signed URLs; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 free screenshots per month, including HTML and PDF rendering.

rate_limits: Plan-dependent: Basic 40 requests per minute, Growth 80 requests per minute, and Scale 150 requests per minute.
use_cases: capture a full-page screenshot of a URL
create signed screenshot URLs for client-side embedding
monitor visual changes on a web page
